batting.name: RD Gaikwad
batting.dismissal: c RR Pant b KK Ahmed

batting.name: R Ravindra
batting.dismissal: c T Stubbs b KK Ahmed

balls.text: a low full toss outside off. Axar mistimes it towards covers for one
a full toss outside off but Porel fails to get the timing right. It goes towards the sweeper cover. The second was on but Axar denies it
full outside off. Porel moves across and helps it over short fine. But there's protection in the deep
a high full toss around off. Axar looks to go big but gets an inside edge onto the body. They pick up a single off the deflection
a full toss. Mistimed towards long-on. But Fizz has overstepped
another wide yorker but this one is too wide
Fizz once again goes for the wide yorker but Porel opens the face of the bat to steer it over short third
A wide yorker. Porel fails to connect and the umpire calls it a wide. CSK have reviewed it, and the replay shows it was just inside the marker
full on the pads. Flicked towards deep square leg

full outside off. Pant goes aerial but ends up slicing it as the bottom hands comes off. It goes miles in the air and Ruturaj Gaikwad, who was settling under it at long-off, had to dive to his left to pouch it
Pathirana errs on the fuller side this time. Pant takes it on the full and slices it over the point region for four. That brings up his fifty as well, off 31 balls - faster than Warner's
almost an action replay. Pant hammers it to the right of Rahane, at long-on, this time. A boundary
Pathirana misses the yorker,allowing Pant to get under it and launch it over long-on. Just clearing the boundary
full around off. Pant stands deep and looks to hoick it towards the leg side. Doesn't middle it but will pick up a couple to deep midwicket
a low full toss outside off. Pant looks to go aerial but doesn't get the timing right. A single to long-on
... which means Pant is on strike now. And he launches this one over deep-backward square leg. The bottom hand comes off the bat in a very Pant-esque manner
a slower ball outside off. Axar was way early into the shot and misses. Dhoni, for the second time in the innings, fails to collect it cleanly and concedes a bye
a low full toss outside off. Pant mistimes it towards midwicket
short outside off and Pant pulls it behind square leg for four. Was a slower one
a slower ball into the pitch. Axar dabs it down to the right of backward point
... and he ends it with a dot. A wide yorker and Pant fails to get bat on it
full and wide. Cuts it towards deep point
full outside off. Pushed towards covers
full outside off. Steered towards deep third
full outside off. Pant foes for the drive and gets an outside edge towards short third
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards wide long-on
one-bounce four. A wide full toss and Pant slices it over covers, with the bottom hand coming off the bat
a bouncer. Rishabh Pant gets an in awkward position as he tries to pull it, and misses
length ball on the pads. Flicked behind square leg
full outside off. Steered towards deep cover
length ball around off. Mistimes the pull between long-on and deep midwicket
wayward. A full toss way outside off. Left alone for a wide
length outside off. Cramped on the cut as he hits it towards extra cover
off stump is flat on the ground this time. Another searing yorker, at 149kph. Stubbs had no clue as the ball crashed into the off and middle stumps
full outside off. Stubbs goes for the drive but gets beaten
150.4kph and the middle stump is out of the ground. An excellent yorker that moves in a touch to beat Marsh's bat and rattle the woodwork
shot around off and Marsh pulls it hard. The ball races away to the deep square leg boundary
short of length outside off. Mistimes the cut towards extra cover
full around off. Pant flicks it uppishly towards deep midwicket
short of length. Marsh rocks back and pulls it over deep square leg for a much-needed six
length outside off. Pant goes for the pull but the ball goes over point off the outer half of the bat. Pant was swining so hard that the bat falls out of his hands
length ball outside off. Pant goes for the falling scoop/pull but fails to middle it. The ball dribbles towards short fine leg
slower short ball outside off. Pant goes for the cut but fails to connect
short of length outside off. Marsh drag-pulls it towards deep midwicket
slower length ball around off. Punched towards extra cover
length ball on the stumps. Pushed towards the vacant midwicket region for one
length outside off. Cuts it towards deep point
length outside off. Chopped towards backward point
full around off and Pant gets into the action now. Goes down on one knee and slogs it over deep midwicket
length outside off. Under-edges the cut towards short third
length outside off. Cuts it to the left of Ravindra at point who makes a partial stop
one-bounce four. Full around off. Marsh walks towards it and lofts it over mid-off. Almost carries all the way
length ball around off. Stopped a bit at Marsh who its it uppishly towards mid-off
a full toss down the leg side. Marsh fails to get his bat on it
a bouncer outside off. Marsh lets it go through
length ball on the pads. Flicked towards square leg
length ball at the stumps. Pant was looking to work it towards midwicket. Gets an inside edge onto the pads
length ball on the pads. Flicked towards deep-backward square leg
length ball angling across. Pant goes for the reverse pull but misses. Jadeja thought there was some bat involved but no appeal from Dhoni
full on the stumps. Pushed to the left of short midwicket who dives across but can make only a partial stop
length outside off. Shaw goes for the cut but gets only an outside edge and Dhoni makes no mistake
length ball around off. Shaw goes for the slog sweep. For a moment, it looked like he didn't really nail it but it kept sailing
length outside off. Swatted towards long-on
length ball on the pads. Flicked towards midwicket
length ball around off. Shaw goes back and flicks it towards deep midwicket
a slower length ball around off. Comes forward and pushes it towards covers
full on the stumps. Pant goes for the flick but misses. An appeal for lbw but the umpire isn't interested. Looked close unless there was an inside edge
what a catch! Slower one, full on the stumps. Warner goes for the reverse scoop and hits it alright but Pathirana jumps to his right and grabs it mid-air and one-handed
full around middle and off. Shaw moves across and touch and flicks it towards deep midwicket
dropped but it wasn't easy. A length ball around off and Warner smashed it straight back. Fizz stretched out his left hand but it didn't stick
length ball around off. Mistimes the pull towards deep midwicket
down the ground and hits it flat towards long-off
Fifty for Warner, off 32 balls. A length ball on the pads. Flicked towards midwicket for a single
length ball around off. Goes back and pulls it towards long-on
length but too outside off. Cuts it behind point. Shaw was looking for the second but had to retrace his steps
too full around off and Warner slog-sweeps it over deep midwicket
another slower one, on the pads though. Flicked towards fine leg, or at least that's what it seemed. But the umpire has given it as a leg bye
a slower one. Shaw pushes it towards mid-off for one
full outside off. Shaw goes for the drive but gets an inside edge to the left of Dhoni who makes the stop
length but too outside off this time. Another wide
wide. Pathirana goes short but it's too high. Shaw was once again looking to ramp it over
beaten! A length ball outside off. Shaw was looking to help it over the wicketkeeper but fails to connect
full on the pads. Flicked towards fine leg
length outside off, and Warner cuts it hard. Fails to get it past point, though
length ball on the stumps. Stops a bit on Warner, who ends up pushing it uppishly towards long-on
length ball around off. Punched towards cover
short of length on the stumps. Warner rocks back and pulls it behind square leg. Almost all the way
short of length around off. Goes back and works it towards deep midwicket
full around off and Shaw goes for the slog sweep. All the way over deep midwicket
length ball on the pads. Flicked towards deep square leg
another slower ball. Warner cuts it towards deep point
a slower one. Length outside off to beat Shaw but nothing is going CSK's way as Dhoni fails to collect it cleanly and ends up conceding a bye
the best of the lot? A length outside off, Shaw gets on his toes and punches it through covers for the third consecutive four
a slower one but the line was wrong. Shaw lets it come to him before using his wrists to work it to the left of fine leg once more
a yorker on leg stump but Shaw does extremely well. Moves towards the off side a touch and flicks it to the left of short fine leg
length ball angling towards the pads. Hits Warner on the thigh and bounces behind point. Mustafizur has bowled a no-ball though
No respite for CSK. Width outside off and Warner pounces on it. Smashes it through cover. Three fours and a six in the last five balls now
length ball at the stumps. Warner looks to hoick it on the leg side but doesn't middle a it. A single to wide long-on
four more. Short around off. Warner backs away and cuts it over point for another boundary
a full toss outside off and Warner says thank you very much. Hits it through extra cover for four. Chahar is turning out to be expensive
on the pads. Warner goes down and launches it over long leg for his second six
slower short ball. Warner pulls it down behind square leg and sprints back for the second. Good running this time
short and pulled to the left of deep midwicket. Ravindra puts in the chase, and DC are contend with one
141.8kph. Goes for the yorker but errs in length slightly. A touch too full and Warner plays it towards cover
length ball at the stumps. Warner was looking to pull it over square leg but gets an inside edge onto the pads
116.8kph. Slower one, full outside off. Warner reaches out for it and hits it towards covers
full around off and Shaw goes aerial again. This time it lands between extra cover and mid-off who were pedalling back and sideways. Only a single
really went after it. On the fuller side outside off and Shaw threw his bat at it. Over the vacant point region for one-bounce four
full around off and Shaw hits it hard but straight back towards the bowler who stops it in is follow-through
117.8kph. A slower one, floated around off. Pushed towards mid-off

length ball on the stumps. Warner once again goes aerial but is cramped by the inward movement of the ball. As a result, he doesn't get full power behind it, but it's enough to clear mid-on, who puts in a chase and flicks it back
a bouncer, angling across. Warner was first looking to pull it but withdraws his shot in the end
length ball around off. Pushed towards covers

into the stands. And you didn't need to watch it, the sound off the bat was enough to tell you how well Warner had it. Was slightly short and Warner went down on one knee and smashed it over deep square leg
length ball on the stumps. Pushed to the right of mid-on for one. A direct hit but Shaw was never in trouble
full and straight, almost in the blockhole. Warner punches it back towards the bowler
length ball outside off. Punched behind point
full on the pads. Warner aims for a big hit but doesn't middle it. A single to midwicket
length ball around off, coming in to Warner to cramp him. Defended down the ground
once again some away movement. Shaw gets it from the outer half of the bat this time for a single to deep third
an outside edge but it doesn't carry to Rahane at first slip. Was a length ball around off the seamed away, squaring up Shaw
full and wide and Warner drives it through covers for the first four of the evening
length outside off. Warner goes for the cut but gets too close to the ball. Off the inside half of the bat and onto the pad
length outside off and leaving Warner who pushes at it and gets beaten
misfield. A length ball outside off. Shaw cuts it to the left of point. The fielder dives across but can only get a hand on it
full around off and shaping away. Shaw goes for the drive but fails to middle it. The ball goes uppishly through the gap between cover and point
length ball on the stumps. Shaw flicks it straight towards short midwicket

another full toss, another one dispatched, high over cover... but Delhi Capitals claim victory nevertheless, closed out by 20 runs despite a late Dhoni onslaught! DC are on the board, but so is CSK's Thala
wide blockhole, 142kph and dug out into the covers
another full toss, hoicked away over mid-on! The hair is flowing, the runs are flowing. This is a lost cause but Dhoni is doing his thing for the first time this year
gets the yorker length this time, 142kph outside off. Drilled to long-off, no run
Thala tonking time! Full toss and he utterly Dhonis it into the crowd! One hand off the bat as it sails over midwicket
full, wide and hammered! 140kph and just short of yorker length. Dhoni goes deep and belts it through cover
round the wicket, 138kph on the stumps and Jadeja can only heave it away for a couple to deep midwicket
pitched up, 137kph and Dhoni is well across his stump, batters one down to long-off
goes full and wide of off again, chopped into the ground towards backward point. Another dot
full, misses the yorker, but Dhoni's exocet drive is cut off by the diving Rasikh in the covers! Prevents four, prevents a single. Superb from the sub
nicely done by Mukesh, over the wicket and hits wide blockhole, squirted wide of deep third but they don't run
gets this on the money, 136kph on a wide line, dug out for one
round the wicket, goes full and wide... too wide
finishes with a decent wide yorker, bunted back to the bowler
full, wide and smacked out of the park! That's why Khaleel was nervous...! Dhoni does it in the old style, plants the front foot and honks six over extra cover
goes for the tramlines again, 123kph but sliding wide
high full toss, Jadeja carves it away to deep third... are they going to check for the no-ball? Looked very tight on the replay. On-field umps happy
low full toss, 136kph, Jadeja pings it straight to cover
pitched up in the channel, steered for a single
and again, Khaleel trying to bowl wide of off but pushed outside the guidelines by MS's aura
sprayed outside the tramlines, Dhoni steps across and takes the wide
over the wicket, heaved away through midwicket for two
pitched up and battered through the covers! Wide yorker but misses the mark, Dhoni clubs it in front of the sweeper for four more!
full outside off, carved to deep backward point
full, wide and slashed past the keeper! Jadeaj stretches and swings hard, gets a thick edge for four
dropped at backward point! Wide full toss, Dhoni hangs the bat out and slices the shot... put down by Khaleel, fumbling low to his left! The crowd love that almost as much
short and clubbed away! Thala bing, Thala boom! Rocks on to the back foot and hoicks his first ball of IPL 2024 through backward square leg
short with pace off, slapped to long-off! Stand and deliver from Dube but it's gone first class down the throat of Stubbs. Third wicket for Mukesh, who's only bowled seven balls so far
full, wide and driven to the cover sweeper once again. Just six singles and a wide off the over
another wide yorker right on the money, Jadeja plinks it off side for one
full in the channel, 139kph and Dube slashes it down to deep third
this time Nortje misses the wide yorker, concedes an extra
wide again, this comes out as a low full toss, clubbed to long-off
goes very full and wide, 140kph and Dube toe-ends a slap to cover inside the ring
round the wicket, full and wide and driven to the cover sweeper
short of a length, pace off and jabbed towards square leg for another single
wide blockhole again, 136kph. Well bowled, squeezed back down to long-off
full, wide and driven to the man at wide long-off
goes for the wide yorker, 144kph and Jadeja drags it straight back to Ishant
full and wide, Dube digs it out behind point. And Ishant's size 13s have crossed the popping crease...
short ball, helped away through backward square leg
steps down and crunches past mid-off! Tasty from Jaddu, on the move and drilled to the left of the diving fielder
shortish and swatted through mid-on for a single
fired in straight from round the wicket, tucked to leg

bounce, edged, taken! Lovely stuff from Mukesh, and Rizvi goes first ball! Searching line on off stump and he was looking to close the face, got a thick edge to short third where Khaleel held on to a sharp catch

plinked to long-on, Mukesh strikes! Perfectly executed slower ball and Rahane holes out. Just a little offcutter wide of the stumps and there was no pace for the batter to work with looking to go down the ground. Safely pouched several yards in from the rope. DC tightening their grip
shortish from over the wicket, Rahane chops it down into the pitch past his stumps
round the wicket, 137kph back of a length and skimmed toward short fine leg. Well stopped
dug in short, 146kph and Dube flaps a pull... lands safely on the leg side as Nortje gives chase, but can't reel in the caught-and-bowled
full and smoked! Width on offer and Dube just belts it through extra cover. Doesn't bother to move
pitched up straight, 142kph and dug out into the midwicket region. They push hard and get two, despite a direct hit from Axar running in off the rope
fuller at the pads, Rahane misses with a flick
back of a length, 129kph and spliced back over Nortje's head for one to long-on
flung down fast in the channel wide of off. Dube swings hard and misses
pitched up, 135kph and clipped back down to long-on
full, wide... just outside the tramlines, I think. Signalled wide
full, pace off, 118kph and flicked off the pads for one
goes again, swung away through square leg! Back of a length and he doesn't have to move, just stays still and hoicks it between two boundary riders
short and top-edged fine! Rahane frees the arms and gets the ball away for four past short third
shovelled away into the gap at deep backward square leg and they pick up two
over the wicket, slightly short on fourth stump and cut away to the point sweeper
flicked off the body behind square

angled across, turns inside the bat... was there an edge? Yes, looks like it, but Pant couldn't hold on! Tough chance, went straight to ground. But DC would have loved to get Dube without taking any damage
steps out and clips down the ground

driven... straight back into the buckets! Axar stoops to his left and scoops up the catch, makes the breakthrough for DC. Mitchell hit that pretty well but couldn't keep on top of the bounce. Axar turns and spreads his arms wide to take the acclaim
flat outsde off, chopped into the ground towards backward point
full again, slapped back at the bowler, who gets something on it but can't prevent a single to long-off
full and beefed over cow! Looked like a back-of-the-hander and Mitchell was waiting for it, moving across on off to club six down the ground
tip and run, Rahane just beats the direct hit! Millimetres in it as the Zing bails light up
pinged off the pads, goes high behind square! Full and straight but there to hit. It's a short boundary down there, 64m and into the crowd from Rahane
pace off, 107kph outside off. Mitchell spanks one down to long-off
angling in on the stumps, Rahane flicks one away to deep backward square
fired down on off and prodded into the off side for one more
sliding in and helped leg side for a couple
drags his length back, squirts away off the edge
six-shooter, smacked straight! Mitchell dances down and meets this with the full face, splatted into the sightscreen to ease the pressure
driven into the pitch and Rahane jumps across to wheel away a pull out to deep backward square leg
pushed through on the stumps, 92kph and clipped back down the ground for one
full and straight, slower delivery hits Mitchell on the pads! The bowler likes it, but no one else is in support. Pant doesn't even consider a review
nips back, beats him on the inside! Perfect length from Rasikh and it clears middle and off with Mitchell looking to swipe down the ground
pace off, Mitchell plays it smartly with a turn of the wrists, picks up two into the gap at midwicket
back of a length outside off, 135kph and Rahane chops it down into the turf
short and skiddy, whipped away! Too straight and Rahane helps it around the corner for a boundary
length outside off, thick-edged down to deep third as Mitchell looks to force something
helped down the ground for another single
Mitchell shuffles across and pokes a couple into the off side
tapped into the covers coming forwards
flat outside off, picks out the man in the covers
pushed through on the stumps, Mitchell bunts one ot mid-off
short into the pitch, swung away on the pull
fired in straight and they steal a leg bye as the ball bobbles into the off side
full on off and Rahane bottom-hands this to midwicket
hard length, 144kph, Mitchell attempts to drive on the up and gets an inside edge into his pads. They scamper through as Nortje fields
back of a length, 146kph and steered to backward point
too straight and helped over deep midwicket! Pick-up for six from Rahane, using the 142 clicks to his advantage. Juicy ball on the pads but the timing was superb
fullish, 142kph and thundering into the pads as Rahane whips to leg. No appeal
back of a length, punched into the covers. Another top over from Khaleel
shuffles across and taps this one down
nips away, 140kph and draws the expansive drive. Beaten all ends up
edged between slip and gully! Mitchell fishes in the channel and gets away with it! Khaleel concedes a rare boundary, not that Mitchell new too much about it
pitched up and driven, Rahane can't pierce the covers coming forwards
round the wicket, fired in and dropped into the covers
pinged through backward point, uses the pace and steers it wide of deep third! Back-to-back fours for Rahane, and some respite for CSK after a torrid opening
Rahane finally gets one away, hoicked over midwicket! First boundary of the CSK innings. Not a completely clean connections but heaved just short of the rope
length ball, sliced away through backward point. Mitchell gets off the mark
full length, plinked back past the bowler for a single to mid-on
back of a length, speared towards point
bangs the ball on a length, fourth stump and prodded away
angled across on a length, Mitchell squared up and beaten outside off

short, this time he connects... and a mishit  to mid-on ends Ravindra's stay! That had been coming, second wicket for Khaleel. It was all yellow for Ravindra, but not in the good way. Couldn't get his rhythm and then finally chips a pull straight up. There were two fielders competing to take the catch but in the end Stubbs makes it safe with a tumbling effort running across from mid-off
another bumper, wide of off stump, Ravindra tries to swat a pull and misses again
shorter, invites him to free the arms. Doesn't connect with a cross-batted flail
pitched up and shaping away wide of the stumps. Another almighty yahoo from Ravindra, without success
short of a length into the hip, jabbed square on the leg side
dug into the pitch, 134kph and fended away as Rahane goes back and across. Single into the leg side
slides this down the leg side, wide called
length ball wide of the stumps, Rahane slaps at it but picks out backward point
pitched up, slower delivery wide of off. Ravindra launches into an uppish drive and gets a thick edge down to deep third
bounce and movement from fifth stump, 133kph and it beats the outside edge again
touch short, invites the cross-batted hack from Ravindra. There's enough seam movement to take it through to Pant
round the wicket, back of a length outside off, 136kph and tapped down

seams back in, nicked behind! The extra ball in the over brings a wicket, and it is CSK captain Gaikwad to fall. Expansive drive to a length ball but it only succeeded in feathering an inside edge through to Pant. Khaleel gets a big early breakthrough for DC
sprayed across the bows, wide into the off-side tramlines
fuller, 136kph and punched to the right of mid-off for a single
hard length on fourth stump, chopped down into the covers
back of a length outside off, 139kph and Ravindra has a dip. Wild swing, fails to connect
hint of outswing for Khaleel, defended square with an open bat face
over the wicket, back of a length on fourth stump. Gaikwad dabs it down carefully into the point region and gets off the mark first ball
